summary: Connect intraday liquidity, API banking, cash forecasting and stress scenarios. Explore the five-day course and its practical treasury outputs.
lede: Digital treasury and liquidity risk management focuses on turning cash positions, payment flows and funding assumptions into decision-ready liquidity views. It is for treasury, finance and banking professionals responsible for cash management or liquidity oversight, and develops practical skills in intraday monitoring, payment-data mapping and Excel cash forecasting. Learners also examine stress scenarios, dashboard controls, AI-assisted forecasting and digital currencies, with the latter topics covered conceptually rather than through technical implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage cash positions, payment execution, short-term funding or liquidity oversight. It suits people with working familiarity with treasury or finance processes who need to connect operational cash data with risk decisions.
modules: Basel III and Digital Currency Context
prerequisites: Working knowledge of treasury, corporate finance or banking operations is recommended. No coding or API development is required; exercises focus on treasury data interpretation, control mapping and Excel-based analysis.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
